D91（周日）：第十三周复盘

第 13 周 · 300 分钟。回忆 30、推导 45、集成 115、反证 50、口述与复盘 60。前置阅读见上一讲。

今天要做出什么

整理 AI 全栈作品、复现步骤和投递状态，闭卷解释模型答完与用户验收的区别。

零、闭卷回忆

D90　演示时间不足时应保留哪组证据？

核对

保留工单号、引用版本、用户动作及变更事件，流式链路用一条实际故障解释。

D88　旧版报告中哪些数字不能搬到新版作品页？

核对

只能引用与当前代码、种子及测试口径一致的结果。缺结果写待测和复现入口。

D84　哪种错误会把别人的材料展示给用户？

核对

越权引用单独判为失败，即使答复文本恰好正确也要追到出错的过滤层。

一、知识点与推导

保留真实状态与日期，把练习结果、个人贡献和待补材料分开写。

知识点示例取自当天已通过测试，按语法树排版；需要同一文件中的导入与夹具，不能孤立粘贴运行。完成对应文件后用所列命令复现。

1.1 复原一条时间线

从请求开始到meta、空文本、首个非空文本、终态依次标记。用可注入时钟复算；观察端和起点必须一致。

可运行示例：元数据与空文本不抢占首字

来源：apps/server/src/retrieval/latency.spec.ts。输入、预期结果和断言如下；完整夹具见第四节。

it('元数据与空文本不抢占首字', () => {
    let now = 100;
    const trace = new LatencyTrace(() => now);
    now = 110;
    trace.observe('meta');
    now = 120;
    trace.observe('text', '');
    now = 150;
    trace.observe('text', '中😀');
    now = 160;
    trace.observe('text', '文');
    now = 200;
    expect(trace.finish('completed')).toEqual({
        outcome: 'completed', firstTextMs: 50, totalMs: 100, codePoints: 3,
    });
});

在apps/server运行：

pnpm test src/retrieval/latency.spec.ts -t "元数据与空文本不抢占首字"

推导题：meta先到是否改变firstTextMs？

答案

不改变。首个非空text才触发该时标。

1.2 复原一组统计分母

给出三个已结算请求：completed、cancelled、failed各一个。故障率为1/2，取消数量为1。成功耗时p95只用completed样本，并报告数量。

可运行示例：主动停止与故障分开计数

来源：apps/server/src/retrieval/latency.spec.ts。输入、预期结果和断言如下；完整夹具见第四节。

it('主动停止与故障分开计数', () => {
    const samples = (['completed', 'cancelled', 'failed'] as const)
        .map(outcome => new LatencyTrace(() => 0).finish(outcome));
    expect(summarizeLatency(samples)).toMatchObject({
        settled: 3, completed: 1, cancelled: 1, failed: 1, failureRate: 0.5,
        completedWithText: 0, completedFirstTextP95Ms: null,
    });
});

在apps/server运行：

pnpm test src/retrieval/latency.spec.ts -t "主动停止与故障分开计数"

推导题：把取消算故障会怎样？

答案

计数和分母都改变，得到2/3；这已经换了统计定义。

1.3 把终态与用量分别核对

交互已经停止后，迟到文本不能改回完成；迟到的有效用量仍可能是对账信息。终态与费用有各自的生命周期。

可运行示例：终态只能结算一次且迟到文本无效

来源：apps/server/src/retrieval/latency.spec.ts。输入、预期结果和断言如下；完整夹具见第四节。

it('终态只能结算一次且迟到文本无效', () => {
    let now = 0;
    const trace = new LatencyTrace(() => now);
    now = 20;
    const first = trace.finish('cancelled');
    now = 40;
    trace.observe('text', '迟到');
    expect(trace.finish('completed')).toBe(first);
    expect(first.codePoints).toBe(0);
    expect(Object.isFrozen(first)).toBe(true);
});

在apps/server运行：

pnpm test src/retrieval/latency.spec.ts -t "终态只能结算一次且迟到文本无效"

推导题：取消就可以认定免费吗？

答案

不能；用量可能已发生，缺少结算时保留未知。

二、动手开发

步骤1：闭卷完成十二题

提示1：方向

先口述，不看折叠答案。

提示2：API与文档位置

按今天零节记录不会、依赖提示、能独立复算三种状态。

提示3：伪代码

步骤2：做混合结果变式

提示1：方向

提示2：API与文档位置

LatencyTrace与summarizeLatency负责时钟和终态；UsageMeter与quoteUsage负责用量与演示金额。

提示3：伪代码

表格列：outcome、firstTextMs、totalMs、usage是否完整、knownAmount、amount。三个总额不要直接相加成精确账单。

步骤3：模拟面试并核对证据

提示1：方向

从本周面试题中抽八题，每题先答两分钟，再做一个反例追问。

提示2：API与文档位置

本日复测12个已有专项；两个反证分别破坏终态幂等和用量输入约束。

提示3：伪代码

讲清判断 → 打开证据 → 回答反例 → 记录1/3/7天复测项。

四、本章完整源码

apps/server/src/assistant/cost-quote.spec.ts

import { embeddingUsage, quoteUsage } from './cost-quote.js';
import { UsageMeter } from './usage-meter.js';

describe('演示报价与用量核对', () => {
  it('缺失用量不是零费用', () => {
    const meter = new UsageMeter();
    meter.start();
    expect(quoteUsage(meter.summary())).toMatchObject({
      status: 'unknown', amount: null, knownAmount: '0.000000',
    });
  });
  it('输入输出分价且不把额度当货币', () => {
    expect(quoteUsage({ inputTokens: 10, outputTokens: 3, exact: true, attempts: 1 }))
      .toMatchObject({ amount: '0.000038', tariffKind: 'synthetic', tariffId: 'demo-linear-v1' });
  });
  it('本机embedding计输入token而非维度', () => {
    const usage = embeddingUsage({ prompt_eval_count: 12, embeddings: [Array(1024).fill(0)] });
    expect(usage).toEqual({ inputTokens: 12, outputTokens: 0, exact: true, attempts: 1 });
    expect(quoteUsage(usage).amount).toBe('0.000024');
  });
  it('重试已知部分不能伪装完整账单', () => {
    const meter = new UsageMeter();
    meter.start(); // 第一次失败且没有usage。
    meter.start();
    meter.record({ usage: { prompt_tokens: 10, completion_tokens: 3, total_tokens: 13 } });
    expect(quoteUsage(meter.summary())).toMatchObject({
      attempts: 2, amount: null, knownAmount: '0.000038',
    });
  });
  it('整数微元累计不提前截断小额', () => {
    expect(quoteUsage({ inputTokens: 1, outputTokens: 1, exact: true, attempts: 1 }).amount).toBe('0.000008');
    expect(quoteUsage({ inputTokens: 1_000_000, outputTokens: 1_000_000, exact: true, attempts: 2 }).amount).toBe('8.000000');
  });
  it('非法计数与不可能的零尝试被拒绝', () => {
    for (const count of [NaN, -1, 0.5, 1_000_001]) {
      expect(embeddingUsage({ prompt_eval_count: count }).exact).toBe(false);
    }
    expect(embeddingUsage({}).exact).toBe(false);
    expect(() => quoteUsage({ inputTokens: 1, outputTokens: 0, exact: true, attempts: 0 })).toThrow('USAGE_INVALID');
  });
});

apps/server/src/assistant/cost-quote.ts

import type { UsageSummary } from './usage-meter.js';

// 演示价表，不是供应商报价，更不代表本机实际成本。
export const demoTariff = Object.freeze({
  id: 'demo-linear-v1', currency: 'CNY', inputMicroPerToken: 2n, outputMicroPerToken: 6n,
});

function validate(summary: UsageSummary) {
  const counts = [summary.inputTokens, summary.outputTokens];
  if (counts.some(v => !Number.isSafeInteger(v) || v < 0 || v > 4_000_000) ||
      !Number.isSafeInteger(summary.attempts) || summary.attempts < 0 || summary.attempts > 4 ||
      typeof summary.exact !== 'boolean' ||
      (summary.attempts === 0 && counts.some(v => v !== 0))) throw new Error('USAGE_INVALID');
}

function formatMicro(value: bigint) {
  return (value / 1_000_000n).toString() + '.' + (value % 1_000_000n).toString().padStart(6, '0');
}

export function quoteUsage(summary: UsageSummary) {
  validate(summary);
  const micro = BigInt(summary.inputTokens) * demoTariff.inputMicroPerToken +
    BigInt(summary.outputTokens) * demoTariff.outputMicroPerToken;
  const knownAmount = formatMicro(micro);
  return {
    tariffId: demoTariff.id, currency: demoTariff.currency, tariffKind: 'synthetic' as const,
    status: summary.exact ? 'complete-usage' as const : 'unknown' as const,
    amount: summary.exact ? knownAmount : null, knownAmount,
    attempts: summary.attempts,
  };
}

// embed只有输入token；向量维度不属于completion token。
export function embeddingUsage(raw: unknown): UsageSummary {
  const count = raw && typeof raw === 'object' && 'prompt_eval_count' in raw ? raw.prompt_eval_count : undefined;
  const exact = typeof count === 'number' && Number.isSafeInteger(count) && count >= 0 && count <= 1_000_000;
  return { inputTokens: exact ? count : 0, outputTokens: 0, exact, attempts: 1 };
}

import { LatencyTrace, p95, summarizeLatency } from './latency.js';

describe('流式请求延迟口径', () => {
  it('元数据与空文本不抢占首字', () => {
    let now = 100;
    const trace = new LatencyTrace(() => now);
    now = 110; trace.observe('meta');
    now = 120; trace.observe('text', '');
    now = 150; trace.observe('text', '中😀');
    now = 160; trace.observe('text', '文');
    now = 200;
    expect(trace.finish('completed')).toEqual({
      outcome: 'completed', firstTextMs: 50, totalMs: 100, codePoints: 3,
    });
  });
  it('主动停止与故障分开计数', () => {
    const samples = (['completed', 'cancelled', 'failed'] as const)
      .map(outcome => new LatencyTrace(() => 0).finish(outcome));
    expect(summarizeLatency(samples)).toMatchObject({
      settled: 3, completed: 1, cancelled: 1, failed: 1, failureRate: 0.5,
      completedWithText: 0, completedFirstTextP95Ms: null,
    });
  });
  it('无样本的分位数不是零', () => {
    expect(p95([])).toBeNull();
    expect(summarizeLatency([]).failureRate).toBeNull();
    expect(summarizeLatency([new LatencyTrace(() => 0).finish('cancelled')]))
      .toMatchObject({ failureRate: null, completedTotalP95Ms: null });
  });
  it('终态只能结算一次且迟到文本无效', () => {
    let now = 0;
    const trace = new LatencyTrace(() => now);
    now = 20;
    const first = trace.finish('cancelled');
    now = 40; trace.observe('text', '迟到');
    expect(trace.finish('completed')).toBe(first);
    expect(first.codePoints).toBe(0);
    expect(Object.isFrozen(first)).toBe(true);
  });
  it('时钟回退与非法输入不会成为负延迟', () => {
    let now = 10;
    const trace = new LatencyTrace(() => now);
    now = 9;
    expect(() => trace.finish('completed')).toThrow('BAD_CLOCK');
    expect(() => new LatencyTrace(() => NaN)).toThrow('BAD_CLOCK');
    expect(() => p95([NaN])).toThrow('BAD_DURATION');
  });
  it('nearest rank不修改输入并只聚合成功耗时', () => {
    const values = Array.from({ length: 20 }, (_, i) => 20 - i);
    expect(p95(values)).toBe(19);
    expect(values[0]).toBe(20);
    const sample = { firstTextMs: 2, totalMs: 10, codePoints: 2 };
    expect(summarizeLatency([
      { ...sample, outcome: 'completed' },
      { ...sample, totalMs: 1000, outcome: 'failed' },
    ]).completedTotalP95Ms).toBe(10);
  });
});

apps/server/src/retrieval/latency.ts

export type Outcome = 'completed' | 'failed' | 'cancelled';
export type LatencySample = Readonly<{
  outcome: Outcome; firstTextMs: number | null; totalMs: number; codePoints: number;
}>;

// 一个请求一个实例；只保留数字，不记录业务正文。
export class LatencyTrace {
  private readonly started: number;
  private last: number;
  private first: number | null = null;
  private codePoints = 0;
  private result?: LatencySample;

  constructor(private readonly clock: () => number = () => performance.now()) {
    this.started = clock();
    if (!Number.isFinite(this.started)) throw new Error('BAD_CLOCK');
    this.last = this.started;
  }

  private elapsed() {
    const now = this.clock();
    if (!Number.isFinite(now) || now < this.last) throw new Error('BAD_CLOCK');
    this.last = now;
    return now - this.started;
  }

  observe(kind: 'meta' | 'text', text = '') {
    if (this.result) return;
    const elapsed = this.elapsed();
    if (kind !== 'text' || text.length === 0) return;
    if (this.first === null) this.first = elapsed;
    this.codePoints += Array.from(text).length;
  }

  finish(outcome: Outcome): LatencySample {
    if (this.result) return this.result;
    this.result = Object.freeze({
      outcome, firstTextMs: this.first, totalMs: this.elapsed(), codePoints: this.codePoints,
    });
    return this.result;
  }
}

export function p95(values: readonly number[]): number | null {
  if (values.some(n => !Number.isFinite(n) || n < 0)) throw new Error('BAD_DURATION');
  if (!values.length) return null;
  return [...values].sort((a, b) => a - b)[Math.ceil(values.length * 0.95) - 1]!;
}

// 本章只聚合已结算样本；主动取消不属于故障分母。
export function summarizeLatency(samples: readonly LatencySample[]) {
  const completed = samples.filter(s => s.outcome === 'completed');
  const failed = samples.filter(s => s.outcome === 'failed').length;
  const cancelled = samples.filter(s => s.outcome === 'cancelled').length;
  const eligible = completed.length + failed;
  return {
    settled: samples.length, completed: completed.length, failed, cancelled,
    failureRate: eligible ? failed / eligible : null,
    completedTotalP95Ms: p95(completed.map(s => s.totalMs)),
    completedFirstTextP95Ms: p95(completed.flatMap(s => s.firstTextMs === null ? [] : [s.firstTextMs])),
    completedWithText: completed.filter(s => s.firstTextMs !== null).length,
  };
}
